<script>
    (() => {
      const filter = document.querySelector('.prod-filter');
      const checkboxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.prod-filter input[type="checkbox"]')];
      const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.prod-document-row')];
      const search = document.querySelector('.prod-search input[type="search"]');
      const sort = document.querySelector('.prod-search button');
      filter?.querySelector('button[type="reset"]')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => { checkbox.checked = false; });
        if (search) search.value = '';
        rows.forEach((row) => { row.hidden = false; });
      });
      search?.addEventListener('input', () => {
        const query = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        rows.forEach((row) => { row.hidden = query && !row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(query); });
      });
      sort?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const list = document.querySelector('.prod-document-list');
        if (!list) return;
        const ascending = sort.dataset.order !== 'asc';
        sort.dataset.order = ascending ? 'asc' : 'desc';
        [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
          const aDate = a.querySelector('.prod-document-row__date')?.textContent || '';
          const bDate = b.querySelector('.prod-document-row__date')?.textContent || '';
          return ascending ? aDate.localeCompare(bDate) : bDate.localeCompare(aDate);
        }).forEach((row) => list.append(row));
      });
    })();
  </script>
